messages:
alia: Quick heads-up — Customer Omnify pushed back on the observability surface. They need: per-route cost breakdown, error-trace retention for 7d, and the ability to dial sampling per-service before we call this GA. Asking for this in 2 weeks.
kevin: Oof. Per-route cost + 7d traces will bump our storage/ingest. Do we have an estimate? :thinking_face:
maria: Rough calc: enabling 7d full traces at current RPS ~ +18% infra cost. If we sample at 5% for non-error requests and 100% for error traces we can keep it <5% delta.
kevin: That sounds promising. Can we make sampling config per-route? customers want control by route/model/priority.
tom: We have per-route labels already in the pipeline. Exposing a sampling policy per route is extra API + UI work but not huge. Backend knobs exist.
sophie: Proposal: two-phase launch. Phase 1 (MVP): dashboards + per-route token cost summary + sampling controls (global default + route override) + error-trace fast-path (always keep last N errors). Phase 2: per-customer retention options + 7d full-trace retention toggle and cost alerts.
alia: Nice. What are minimal acceptance criteria for Phase 1 to sign off?
maria: Acceptance (Phase1):
- per-route cost card on console (last 7d)
- sampling UI to set default % and route overrides
- error-trace capture for any traced request with status >= 500 (kept for 72h)
- budget alert when predicted monthly cost delta > 10%
- unit tests + canary (5% of traffic)
can we ship that in 2 weeks?
kevin: Timeline is tight. Backend + billing mapping will take ~6 dev days. UI + QA ~5 days. Can do if we cut scope on the budget alert (send only internal notif first).
tom: On the implementation side, here's a recommended config snippet for sampling we'll use in k8s config map:
```yaml
sampling:
  default_pct: 5
  routes:
    "\/v1\/generate": 25
    "\/v1\/embed": 1
  error_override: true
  error_keep_hours: 72
```
kevin: That aligns with Maria's cost calc. We should also add a cost projection endpoint for the console so UI can show "estimated monthly delta" before toggling.
sophie: For canary: start 5% of accounts on new pipeline with sampling controls enabled, hold for 48h, check cost delta and error visibility. If good, ramp to 25% then GA.
alia: Customer asks also included per-model cost attribution (token-level). We need to map token usage -> model variant -> route. That's existing telemetry but the console card needs a rollup.
maria: We'll expose a "cost attribution" aggregation job that runs hourly and writes a summary index. Queryable by route/model/customer.
kevin: Action items:
- kevin: prototype cost-projection endpoint (API + mock) — 2d
- tom: wire sampling config into runtime and add route override flags — 3d
- maria: update storage estimate + confirm retention SLA for error traces — 1d
- sophie: wire console cards + MVP sampling UI (internal alert only) — 4d
- alia: coordinate canary customers + send comms to Omnify — today
assign owners and confirm by EOD?
sophie: I can pick up the UI work. Will mock in figma and post links.
kevin: I'll start the endpoint and a short load/run to sanity-check cost numbers.
deploy-bot: CI build started for branch "obs\/sampling-mvp" — tests queued. :rocket:
alia: Thanks. Let's meet tomorrow 10am for a quick unblock sync. If anyone hits a blocker, ping #eng-oncall and drop notes here. :thumbsup:
